request.topic: How I see every client's chats, notes and next follow-up on one board in ActivityTracker

brand.name: ActivityTracker
brand.oneLiner: We help sales reps manage clients, chats, follow-ups and targets in one app so they can keep their work moving.
brand.audience: working adult: Sales-oriented self-employed professionals and coaches
brand.facts:
- What it offers: We help sales reps manage clients, chats, follow-ups and targets in one app so they can keep their work moving. It brings CRM, a shared WhatsApp inbox, tasks and goals together in one phone app, with activity logged in one tap.
- Who it serves: Sales-oriented self-employed professionals and coaches
brand.rules: MY BRAND RULES (these win over any other emoji, hashtag or link guidance): Use 5 hashtags at most.
brand.speaker: business

formulas.name: Contrarian take
formulas.template: Most people say {common advice}. After {what you have seen}, I disagree.
formulas.example: Everyone says clear your home loan early. After 9 years of reading CPF statements, I'm not so sure.
formulas.trap: Arguing against advice nobody actually follows.

formulas.name: Number reveal
formulas.template: I {did something} {N} times. Here is what came out of it.
formulas.example: I reviewed 40 young families' coverage this year. 31 had the same gap.
formulas.trap: Hiding the number below the first line.

formulas.name: Mistake confession
formulas.template: {What it cost} is what {one mistake} cost me.
formulas.example: A client's trust is what one rushed fact-find cost me in my first year.
formulas.trap: A humblebrag dressed up as a mistake.

hooks.text: Most people say keep chats separate. We say bring follow-ups together.
See chats, notes and next steps together. Here’s what one board brings.
Lost context is what one scattered-chat mistake can cost.
